quest.title: Wangshu Take-Away
quest.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got something else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Well, have it then. I'll figure something out.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you, then. This Stir-Fried Filet requires careful treatment, so avoid any unnecessary complications.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So, <color=#00E1FFFF>don't touch any weird elements while you're out there, and don't move too fast</color>.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Should be here any moment now...

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks. I'm surprised that Wangshu Inn delivers this far out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Aye, you heard right. Ling'guan ordered some Stir-Fried Filet before heading northwest.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If it isn't too much trouble, deliver it to her while it's hot, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If you meet with an accident along the way, come back here and I'll make you another serving.

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Should be here any moment now...
